race.comment: IMAGINATION (1) made an impressive debut when strongly fancied and hit the ground running with a fast early split, paving the way for a 2.25 lengths win at this track over 300m in 16.38. Looks promising and can go on with it. MIDNIGHT TEARS (3) placed on debut by 2.25 lengths (16.54) at this track over 300m. Can find the frame again this time. STREET LEGAL (2) was quickly into stride on debut to score by 0.8 lengths (16.70) at this track over 300m. Drawn to be prominent early. Will break from the same draw this time. This tougher but expected to be in the finish. ASTON HOPKINS (8) cannot be underestimated.
